local.title: Choose the radiator
local.description:
1. Put the radiator in pairing mode, as in the GoodHome app: on the radiator, press **Settings** (gear icon), then **Connection**, then **Add**.
2. It then appears below under its name (**GOODHOME-XXXX**): choose it.

A radiator only shows its name in pairing mode. A radiator already paired with Home Assistant appears with its address. Each radiator is added on its own.

pair.title: Pair {name}
pair.description:
**{name}** is in pairing mode. Click **Submit** right away: pairing takes up to a minute.

If pairing mode has ended in the meantime, redo the 3 steps on the radiator (**Settings** → **Connection** → **Add**) just before submitting. Keep the radiator within range of the Bluetooth adapter (same room or the next one).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate GoodHome
reauth_confirm.description: The password for {email} is no longer valid. Enter the new one.

data_description.password: New password of your GoodHome app account.

error.pair_failed: Pairing failed ({error}). Redo the 3 steps on the radiator and try again; if it keeps failing, bring the Bluetooth adapter closer.
error.not_found: The radiator is no longer seen over Bluetooth. Check that it is switched on and bring the Bluetooth adapter closer, then try again.
error.pair_rejected: The radiator refused pairing: it was not in pairing mode. Redo the 3 steps on the radiator, then click Submit right away.
error.no_radiator_in_pairing_mode: No radiator in pairing mode yet. Put the radiator in pairing mode (Settings → Connection → Add), wait a few seconds, then click Submit to search again.
error.no_connectable_adapter: No Bluetooth adapter can connect to a radiator. Add a Bluetooth adapter to Home Assistant (or an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy with active connections), then click Submit to try again.
